title: Persona Setting Pitfall: Persistent Outgroup Biases in Large Language Models Arising from Social Identity Adoption
reasoning: The paper focuses on social identity adoption and its impact on political and gender biases in LLMs. While the political value statements touch on topics that intersect with moral or ethical views (e.g., abortion, medical care access), the study evaluates them as facets of political identity rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or ethical systems directly.
